d: The Santhal Hul of 1855–56 was one of the major tribal uprisings against British rule in India. In this episode of Tarikh, we explore the history of the Santhal Rebellion in Jharkhand, from the historic gathering at Bhognadih to the struggle led by Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand and Bhairav Murmu. We also uncover the lesser-known story of Phulo and Jhano Murmu, remembered in Santhal oral traditions for their courage and resistance. Discover the story of Santhal Hul, Santhal Pargana, British rule, zamindars, moneylenders, tribal resistance, land rights and the fight for identity. A story of…
